body.prompt: Camera stays at this angle with a slow gentle drift, no tilt. As he talks, his left hand lifts off the desk and makes a calm emphasizing gesture, then returns to the desk; right hand moves slightly. Keep the exact same man, navy two-piece suit, white shirt, wide dark silk tie, white pocket square, watch, microphone and library background as the reference image. Black and white, soft film grain, warm light from above. The framing stays at or below the shirt collar the whole time: never tilt up, never show the chin, jaw, mouth or face. He never writes; the notebook stays untouched. Calm, natural movement. No text, no logos.
